title: Pickalo: Leveraging 6D Pose Estimation for Low-Cost Industrial Bin Picking
abstract: arXiv:2604.04690v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bin picking in real industrial environments remains challenging due to severe clutter, occlusions, and the high cost of traditional 3D sensing setups. We present Pickalo, a modular 6D pose-based bin-picking pipeline built entirely on low-cost hardware. A wrist-mounted RGB-D camera actively explores the scene from multiple viewpoints, while raw stereo streams are processed with BridgeDepth to obtain refined depth maps suitable for accurate collision reasoning. Object instances are segmented with a Mask-RCNN model trained purely on photorealistic synthetic data and localized using the zero-shot SAM-6D pose estimator. A pose buffer module fuses multi-view observations over time, handling object symmetries and significantly reducing pose noise. Offline, we generate and curate large sets of antipodal grasp candidates per object; online, a utility-based ranking and fast collision checking are queried for the grasp planning. Deployed

translated_title: Pickalo：利用6D位姿估计实现低成本工业料箱拣选
translated_abstract: 真实工业环境中的料箱拣选仍然具有挑战性，原因在于严重的杂乱堆叠、遮挡问题以及传统3D传感设备的高成本。我们提出了Pickalo，一个完全基于低成本硬件构建的模块化6D位姿料箱拣选流水线。腕部安装的RGB-D相机从多个视角主动探索场景，同时原始双目视觉流通过BridgeDepth进行处理，以获得适合精确碰撞推理的精细化深度图。物体实例通过一个纯粹在照片级真实感合成数据上训练的Mask-RCNN模型进行分割，并使用零样本SAM-6D位姿估计器进行定位。位姿缓冲模块随时间融合多视角观测，处理物体对称性问题并显著降低位姿噪声。在离线阶段，我们为每个物体生成并筛选大量的对跖抓取候选集；在线阶段，通过基于效用的排序和快速碰撞检查来进行抓取规划。该系统已部署……
tldr: Pickalo提出了一套完全基于低成本硬件的模块化6D位姿估计料箱拣选流水线，通过多视角RGB-D主动探索、纯合成数据训练的分割模型、零样本位姿估计以及时序位姿融合，有效解决了真实工业环境中严重杂乱、遮挡和传统3D传感成本高昂的难题。
en_tdlr: Pickalo is a modular 6D pose-based bin-picking pipeline built entirely on low-cost hardware, which addresses severe clutter, occlusions, and the high cost of traditional 3D sensing in real industrial environments through multi-view RGB-D active exploration, synthetic-data-trained segmentation, zero-shot pose estimation, and temporal multi-view pose fusion.
